adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a new behavior in `PostRevisor#update_post` to conditionally skip validations (`@post.save(validate: !@opts[:skip_validations])`) and `TopicEmbed.import` relies on it by calling `revisor.revise!(..., skip_validations: true, ...)` when updating an existing embedded post. However, the update example in `spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb` updates with a nontrivial string (`"muhahaha new contents!"`) and `TopicEmbed.import` also appends an `imported_from` footer before revising, so the spec does not exercise a scenario where validations would fail without `skip_validations`. That means the test suite doesn’t actually demonstrate why the new skip-validation save path matters (e.g., for very short updates), even though the production code now depends on it for robustness.
